entries.english:
Receipts and accounting records for the accounts of the revenues belonging to the von Rosenbach family, later the baronial von Görtz family and then the von Schrautenbach family, in the Wetterau (Lindheim and environs)

Contents: 1693–1695; 1701/02; 1704/05; 1706/07; 1707/08; 1720/21–1723/24

Date range: 1693–1724
